versions.changelog:
Initial release of liblibai skill.

- Provides AI image generation services powered by the LiblibAI API.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, Ultra models, ComfyUI workflows, and file uploads.
- Allows configuration of API access and base URL.
- Requires node and npm, with installation via the liblibai npm package.
- Licensed under MIT.
